tooltip: Special Effects – Applies a special visual effect to the camera output
content1: Applies a special visual effect to the camera output: Normal, Black And White, GrayScale, Negative, or Sketch.
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x03, SET 0x04.
SpecialEffectCU55 Enum indicates the effect to be applied:
  1. EFFECT_NORMAL (0x01) – No effect applied.
  2. EFFECT_BLACK_WHITE (0x04) – Black and white effect.
  3. EFFECT_GREYSCALE (0x07) – Greyscale effect.
  4. EFFECT_NEGATIVE (0x08) – Negative effect.
  5. EFFECT_SKETCH (0x10) – Sketch effect.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current special effect mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the special effect mode of the camera.

tooltip: ROI Auto-Exposure – Selects the region of interest used by auto exposure
content1: Selects the Region of Interest (ROI) used by the auto-exposure algorithm: Full (entire frame) or Manual (a user-selected region). In Manual mode the window size (1 to 8) is chosen from the Value drop-down. This control is available only when the UVC exposure is set to Auto.
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x07, SET 0x08.
ROIAutoExpModeCU55 Enum specifies the ROI auto-exposure mode:
  1. AE_Face (0x00) – Expose based on the detected face region.
  2. AE_Full (0x01) – Expose based on the full frame.
  3. AE_Manual (0x02) – Expose based on a manually specified region.
  4. AE_Disabled (0x03) – ROI-based auto exposure is disabled.
In Manual mode the X/Y coordinates are scaled from the video resolution to the 0-255 range and sent with the window size.
ROIModeResultCU55 struct holds the current ROI mode and window size.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current ROI auto-exposure mode and window size.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoExpROI(ROIAutoExpModeCU55 roiMode, uint32_t vidW, uint32_t vidH, uint32_t xCord, uint32_t yCord, uint8_t winSize)
setAPIDes: This function sets the ROI auto-exposure mode. For AE_Manual, the video dimensions, ROI centre coordinates and window size are also applied.

tooltip: Exposure Compensation – Adjusts the exposure compensation value in microseconds
content1: Adjusts the auto-exposure compensation value to make the image brighter or darker. Enter a value in microseconds (8000 to 1000000) and click Set. This control is available only when the UVC exposure is set to Auto.
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x13, SET 0x14.
The 32-bit value is sent as 4 bytes, most significant byte first.
Valid range: EXPOSURECOMP_MIN (8000) to EXPOSURECOMP_MAX (1000000). Values outside this range are rejected by the SDK.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current exposure compensation value (in microseconds).
setAPIDes: This function sets the exposure compensation value (range: 8000–1000000 us).

tooltip: Denoise Strength – Adjusts the noise reduction strength applied to the image
content1: Adjusts the level of noise reduction applied to the image. The value ranges from 0 (minimum) to 15 (maximum).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current denoise strength value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the denoise strength of the camera (range: 0–15).

tooltip: Image Capture – Sets the number of frames captured in a still-capture burst
content1: Selects the number of frames (1 to 5) captured in a single still-capture burst.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current burst length of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the burst length of the camera (range: 1–5).

tooltip: Q-Factor – Adjusts the JPEG compression quality factor
content1: Adjusts the JPEG quality factor used for MJPEG/still encoding. Higher values give better image quality with less compression. The value ranges from 10 to 96.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current Q-factor of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the Q-factor of the camera (range: 10–96).

tooltip: Frame Rate Control – Adjusts the camera output frame rate
content1: Adjusts the output frame rate of the camera stream. The slider ranges from 1 to 120 fps; the achievable rate depends on the selected resolution and format.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current frame rate control value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the frame rate control value of the camera.

tooltip: Flip Control – Controls horizontal and vertical image flipping
content1: Flips the camera image horizontally and/or vertically. Both flip options can be enabled or disabled independently.
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x0D, SET 0x0E.
FlipModeCU55 Enum specifies the flip configuration:
  1. BOTH_DISABLE (0x00) – No flipping applied.
  2. HORZ_ONLY (0x01) – Only horizontal flip is applied.
  3. VERT_ONLY (0x02) – Only vertical flip is applied.
  4. BOTH_ENABLE (0x03) – Both horizontal and vertical flips are applied.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flip mode (a FlipModeCU55 value) of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the horizontal and vertical flip of the camera independently.

tooltip: Face Detection – Enables or disables face detection with optional embedded data and overlay rectangle
content1: Enables or disables face detection. When enabled, face detection data can be embedded in the frame (Embedded Data) and a rectangle can be drawn around detected faces (Overlay rectangle).
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x0F, SET 0x10.
Parameters (0x01 = enable, 0x00 = disable):
  1. mode – Face detection on/off.
  2. embedData – Embed face detection data in the frame.
  3. overlayRect – Draw an overlay rectangle on detected faces.
FaceDetectResultCU55 struct holds the current face detection state.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current face detection mode, embedded data state and overlay rectangle state.
setAPIHeading: bool setFaceDetectRect(bool enable, bool embedData, bool overlayRect)
setAPIDes: This function enables or disables face detection and configures the embedded data and overlay rectangle options.

tooltip: Smile Detection – Enables or disables smile detection with optional embedded data
content1: Enables or disables smile detection. When enabled, smile detection data can be embedded in the frame (Embedded Data).
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x11, SET 0x12.
Parameters (0x01 = enable, 0x00 = disable):
  1. mode – Smile detection on/off.
  2. embedData – Embed smile trigger data in the frame.
SmileDetectResultCU55 struct holds the current smile detection state.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current smile detection mode and embedded data state.
setAPIDes: This function enables or disables smile detection and configures the embedded data option.

tooltip: Flash Mode – Selects the flash output mode: Disable, Strobe, or Torch
content1: Selects the flash output mode of the camera: Disable (flash off), Strobe (flash synchronized with frame exposure), or Torch (flash continuously on).
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x18, SET 0x19.
FlashModeCU55 Enum specifies the flash mode:
  1. DISABLE (0x00) – Flash is turned off.
  2. STROBE (0x01) – Strobe flash mode.
  3. TORCH (0x02) – Torch (continuous) flash mode.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flash mode (a FlashModeCU55 value) of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the flash mode of the camera.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Reduces flicker caused by artificial lighting
content1: Reduces image flicker caused by artificial lighting. Off disables flicker compensation, Auto detects the mains frequency automatically, and Manual lets you select 50 Hz or 60 Hz from the Frequency drop-down.
content2:
Camera control ID 0x97. GET 0x1A, SET 0x1B.
FlickerModeCU55 Enum specifies the anti-flicker mode:
  1. MODE_DISABLE (0x00) – Anti-flicker is off.
  2. MODE_50Hz (0x01) – Manual, 50 Hz.
  3. MODE_60Hz (0x02) – Manual, 60 Hz.
  4. MODE_AUTO (0x03) – Automatic flicker detection.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current anti-flicker mode (a FlickerModeCU55 value) of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the anti-flicker mode of the camera.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the 64-bit serial number of the camera
content1: Reads the unique 64-bit serial number of the camera. This is a read-only property used for device identification.
content2: GET 0x41 (upper 32 bits), then 0x41 with sub-command 0x01 (lower 32 bits). The two halves are combined into a 64-bit value. This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses uint64_t parameter directly (read-only)
bool get64BitSerialNumber(uint64_t &outSerial);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the 64-bit unique serial number of the camera.
setAPIDes: Serial Number is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Serial Number.
// Use get64BitSerialNumber() to read the device serial number.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Reads the firmware version of the camera
content1: Reads the firmware version of the camera, formatted as Major.Minor1.Minor2.Minor3. This is a read-only property.
content2: Read through the common HID firmware-version request (CameraHID::readFirmwareVersion). This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses std::string parameter directly (read-only)
bool readFirmwareVersion(std::string &version);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the firmware version string from the camera.
setAPIDes: Firmware Version is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Firmware Version.
// Use readFirmwareVersion() to read the current firmware version.

tooltip: Default – Resets all camera extension settings to factory defaults
content1: Resets all See3CAM_CU55 extension controls to their factory default values.
getAPIDes: Set to Default is a write-only action. There is no get function for this operation.
getAPICode:
// No get API available for Set to Default.
// Use setToDefault() to reset the camera to factory settings.
setAPIDes: This function resets all camera properties to their factory default values.
